Hi Asha — appreciate the clarity. I put together a short commit playbook and an early hardware slate for "on-prem Dedicated" that maps to the eval gates we usually run. High-level summary below; I attached a draft MAP and a rough lead-time workbook.

Key recommendations (initial production slice):
- Baseline compute: 6 x A100 80GB (expected steady-state throughput headroom, supports batching and KV cache for your traffic profile).
- Buffer plan: +2 GPUs for peak/spike capacity (total 8) and a configured autoscale burst pool in the Dedicated fleet for hosted fallback during very large tails.
- Minimum commitment term for predictable pricing & procurement assistance: 12 months.
- On-prem lead-time: 10–14 weeks from PO to rack-ready (8 wks procurement + 2–6 wks on-site integration depending on vendor backlog).

Evaluation acceptance criteria to include in MAP:
1) Latency: p95 generation < 350ms for chat with 4k context, p99 < 700ms for embeddings requests under expected concurrency.
2) Throughput: sustain 100 qps embeddings with <=5% error rate for 30m continuous window.
3) Feature gates: KV cache hit rate > 60% on repeated prompt families, quantized riff validation within 3% quality delta vs baseline.
4) Security: SOC2 attestation or equivalent for the private control plane; hardware inventory accessible to StellarHealth.

Next steps I propose:
- We finalize the MAP doc and MAP checklist by Tue 2026-08-10.
- Procurement review week of 2026-08-17.
- Target PO by 2026-08-28 to hit earliest lead-time.

I'll loop in Lauren from Solutions to draft the on-prem installation runbook and Marcus to size the burst/fallback config.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
